scope: Engineering verification of LWD reference finetuning; not scientific effectiveness validation

tests.note: First restricted run passed 48/49; legacy evaluation subprocess was blocked by macOS OpenMP shared-memory access. Same complete suite passed in an environment permitting local shared memory.

checks: vendored source hashes and import-only changes
adapter equals original AutoencoderKL computational methods exactly in FP32
RGB average adaptation and reject partial weights before mutation
KL sum/mean factor 360 and independent feature/KL coefficients
CSEM feature loss agrees with explicit AlexNet activations
LPIPS agrees exactly with official slice construction and calibration
both frozen feature losses propagate gradients to predictions without weight downloads
synthetic-pretrained LPIPS+EMA+dropout continuation equals uninterrupted training exactly for VAE, optimizer, EMA, loss network and metrics
v2 checkpoint evaluation and differentiable raw-log10rho / Fortran-order inference
missing required inputs are reported before creating run output
configuration paths remain project-relative when launched elsewhere

smoke_training.initialization: random reduced model; no perceptual loss

reference.name: smoke_original_core
reference.basis: CompVis core + LWD pipeline verification only
assumptions: Reduced 32-channel network; no pretrained or perceptual weights; two short CPU epochs.

Hyy/Hzz reconstruction response errors or GN inversion effectiveness
Identity and published experiment version of the inverse-scattering paper
